_note: Robinhood Chain mainnet. Phase 2 uses it read-only (wallet connect + public balances; trades simulated). Before the Phase 5 external audit Velum contracts may be deployed here only as the guarded beta (contracts/script/Deploy.s.sol checks this token list against its own; docs/07-mainnet-guarded-beta.md). Tickers are not unique on-chain: always match by exact address.

_verification.chainId: docs.robinhood.com/chain/connecting and /chain/add-network-to-wallet list 4663; RPC eth_chainId returned 4663.
_verification.rpcUrl: docs.robinhood.com/chain/add-network-to-wallet (Default RPC URL). Public endpoint is rate-limited (HTTP 429 under parallel calls); use a provider URL in RPC_URL / NEXT_PUBLIC_RPC_URL for production.
_verification.multicall3: eth_getCode at the canonical Multicall3 address returned deployed bytecode.
_verification.tokens: Stock token addresses from https://api.robinhood.com/rhj/assets (the source docs.robinhood.com/chain/contracts renders), each confirmed on-chain via name()/symbol()/decimals(). USDG and WETH from docs.robinhood.com/chain/contracts, confirmed on-chain.
_verification.priceFeeds: Chainlink feed proxies NOT verified (data.chain.link was not reachable), so priceFeeds below is empty and PRICE_SOURCE=chainlink refuses to start. Mainnet prices come from Robinhood's official Stock Token API instead (api.robinhood.com/rhj/prices and /rhj/assets, docs.robinhood.com/chain/stock-token-apis; checked 2026-11-15): PRICE_SOURCE=robinhood is required with VELUM_NETWORK=mainnet and PRICE_SOURCE=demo is refused there (apps/workers/src/env.ts).

priceFeeds._note: Chainlink AggregatorV3 proxy per symbol. Only add addresses copied from Chainlink's official Robinhood Chain list.
